title: Zesty Crisp Brazilian Tofu Skewers
description: A pungent and crisp Brazilian dish featuring tahini paste, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this plant-based friendly recipe is sure to delight. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together tahini paste, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the tahini mixture.
Thread the tofu cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the tofu is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
